INBOX_TEAM_ASSIGNMENT.TITLE: Assign teams to inboxes
INBOX_TEAM_ASSIGNMENT.DESCRIPTION: For each set, choose inboxes and the teams that take their chats. The default team takes a chat when no team is chosen from the contact status.
INBOX_TEAM_ASSIGNMENT.TEAMS_HINT: Check the teams, then mark the default with the green check.
INBOX_TEAM_ASSIGNMENT.PICKER_DESCRIPTION: Select the inboxes this set applies to.
INBOX_TEAM_ASSIGNMENT.EMPTY_TEAMS: There are no teams in this account yet.
